items.summary: An arbitrary remote code execution vulnerability exists in HPE Morpheus Manager.

Dynamic Product Gallery for WooCommerce before 3.6.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to inject arbitrary JavaScript via the product_id attribute of the [wc_product_dgallery] and [wc_product_dynamic_gallery] shortcodes. The parse_shortcode_product_dynamic_gallery() function passes product_id only through esc_attr(), and get_gallery_main() prints it unescaped into the a3-wc-dynamic-gallery-init-inline-script inline script as part of a JavaScript variable name, so a value such as 342;alert(document.domain)// breaks out of the declaration. The injected script executes in the browser of any user who views the post, including editors or administrators who preview or approve it.

WPC Product Options for WooCommerce before 4.0.9 contains a price manipulation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to purchase products at an arbitrary price by submitting crafted wpcpo-* option data with a negative price in an add-to-cart request. Attackers can exploit the add_cart_item_data() function in includes/class-cart.php, which stores client-supplied price values without validation and carries them into the order total via before_calculate_totals(), to checkout products at zero or arbitrary cost.

A security vulnerability has been detected in FredrikNoren ungit 1.5.30. This affects the function writeUserConfig of the file source/server.js of the component API Server. The manipulation of the argument launchCommand leads to missing authentication. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A weakness has been identified in FredrikNoren ungit 1.5.30. Affected by this issue is the function credentialsOption of the file source/git-api.js of the component Remote Git API. Executing a manipulation of the argument Remote can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A security flaw has been discovered in RainyGao DocSys up to 2.02.91. Affected by this vulnerability is the function downloadDocRS of the file src/com/DocSystem/controller/DocController.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument path results in path traversal. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
